tagline: Plan, track, and crush your fitness goals — all in one beautiful Notion workspace.
target_buyer: 22-35 year-old fitness beginners and intermediates who already use Notion for work or life and want one unified system to plan, track, and visualize their fitness journey.
pain_point: Tracking workouts, meals, body metrics, and recovery across 4-5 different apps — losing the thread, never seeing the full picture, falling off routines after 3-4 weeks.
promise: One premium Notion dashboard that consolidates training, nutrition, recovery, and goals — with 8+ interconnected databases, automated formulas, and realistic sample data so it feels alive on day one.
value_stack: 8 interconnected Notion databases (Workouts, Exercises, Body Metrics, Nutrition Log, Goals, Habits, Recovery, Progress Photos)
1 master Home dashboard with live rollups and progress widgets
5 view types per primary database: Calendar, Gallery, Table, Board, Timeline

12 working formulas in valid Notion syntax (Progress %, Days Remaining, Consistency Score, Streak Day, Days Since Last Session, Estimated 1RM, Volume, Macro Split %, Δ vs Start, 7-Day Rolling Avg, Recovery Score, Consistency %)
Realistic 4-week sample data for fictional user 'Alex' — math reconciled, typo-fixed
8 ready-to-import CSV files (notion-csv-imports/) for instant Notion data population
Lite 4-database mobile variant spec (lite-mobile-variant.md) for buyers who want simpler
Beginner (3-day), Intermediate (4-day), and Advanced (5-day PPL) training programs documented in-page
Mobile-friendly navigation order — works on phone, tablet, and desktop
3 cover concepts: architecture-map node graph (recommended), editorial dumbbell, typography-only
PDF + Loom-ready walkthrough script + 5-minute quickstart at top of instructions.md
Lifetime updates — send buyers the changelog with every v1.x release
variants: Lite mobile (4 databases: Workouts + Nutrition + Habits + Goals)
